prompt: PULL REQUEST: fix(common): keep HTML response preview readable in dark theme DESCRIPTION (author's words, may be technical): Closes #6665 — light color-scheme on HTML preview iframe/srcdoc; includes tests. --- ## Summary by cubic Fixes the HTML response preview being unreadable in dark themes. The preview iframe inherited the app's dark `color-scheme`, which made unstyled HTML text invisible (light text on a light background). The preview now forces a light color-scheme unless the response HTML already declares its own. - Extracts srcdoc building (base href injection and color-scheme handling) into a `buildHtmlPreviewSrcdoc` helper. - Adds tests covering base href injection, color-scheme forcing, and case-insensitive meta name detection. Written for commit 600aba00d49b04f2944780ba5b3897c0e51577d0. Summary will update on new commits. system:
You write pull-request risk briefs for a QA lead who knows the product (Hoppscotch, an API client)
but not its code. Use plain product language: screens, buttons, tabs, what a user does.
Never mention file names, code identifiers, components, functions, keys, or programming terms.
Only talk about items given to you, and cite them by their ids exactly as given.
